meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 AST-grep、grep、LSP 等工具按 9 个维度扫描你的代码库,找技术债,并在仓库根目录写出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,里面含严重度分级、工时估算和排好序的修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计、架构评审或清理计划时触发,针对整个仓库或指定目录跑一遍。

say.text: 帮我做一次技术债审计,输出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 扫描 9 个维度并写入仓库根目录

say.text: 对 src 目录跑一次代码健康检查,标出严重度和工时
say.note: 每条发现会带 file:line:col 引用

say.text: 审计完给我 Top 5 优先修复项和快赢清单
say.note: 快赢项为 30 分钟内可修的任务

howto.what_en: Claude audits your codebase for technical debt across 9 dimensions using AST-grep, grep, LSP and native tooling, then writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md in the repo root with severity, effort estimates and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review or cleanup planning.

say_en.text: Run a tech debt audit and write TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Scans 9 dimensions, writes file to repo root

say_en.text: Do a code health check on src/ with severity and effort
Give me the top 5 priorities and the quick wins list
say_en.note: Quick wins are under 30 minutes each
